Best regards,
Jessica Stone

This ambiguity requires the SOA to clarify which specific item variants and shipment options the customer wants before proceeding with a quote.

We would like to request a quote for the following items for our cafe:

- Rug (we are looking to add one to our lounge area, but are open to your suggestions)

Could you please let us know which variants are available and the earliest possible shipment dates? We are flexible with the delivery timing if some options are not immediately available.

Best regards,
German Cafe

Fresh Foods North Europe

I'm looking to get a quote for a couple of things for an upcoming event, and I wanted to check on availability and shipping options before finalizing.
